scripts.build: cd .. && npx electron-vite build && rm -rf relay/public/app && cp -R out/renderer relay/public/app && node -p "require('./package.json').version" > relay/public/app/version.txt
scripts.deploy: npm run build && sh -c '. ./.env 2>/dev/null; wrangler deploy ${RELAY_DOMAIN:+--domain "$RELAY_DOMAIN"}'
